description.value: My-Chosen is a beloved family-owned country destination on Happy Valley Road outside Victoria, operating since 1987 and grown into a complex that includes a full-service cafe, a pizza shop, and a Sugar Shack dessert bar serving banana splits and fresh-baked goods. The property features a 'Critter Corner' with live animals and an unhurried, roam-at-your-own-pace atmosphere that reviewers describe as a genuine escape from the city. Touring cyclists will find hearty comfort-food plates, gluten-sensitive options, and a memorable sweet stop — all under one rustic roof.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms a real, operating multi-venue complex at 4492 Happy Valley Rd, Victoria, BC. Phone numbers (three lines for Cafe, Pizza, Sugar Shack) and address are confirmed via the website footer; OSM had no phone entry so the cafe main line is sourced from the website. Vegetarian and gluten-sensitive menu options are confirmed by the 'Hungry Hippie' veggie pizza listing and the explicit 'Gluten-Sensitive' menu tab; online takeout ordering is confirmed by multiple 'Order Online' links throughout the site. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging appears anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; three phone numbers sourced from website (Cafe: 250-474-2333, Pizza: 250-474-5576, Sugar Shack: 250-474-2380) — cafe main line used in this record.
OSM address omits city, province, and postal code; website footer confirms 'Victoria, BC' but no postal code is listed anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, long-established, publicly accessible cafe and restaurant complex confirmed open via a current, detailed website. Clear value to touring cyclists as a full-service food stop with hearty meals and desserts.
enrichment_extras.notes: The complex comprises distinct branded operations (My-Chosen Cafe, My-Chosen Pizza, My-Chosen Sugar Shack, Critter Corner) sharing one address. Additional OSM records may exist or be warranted for the pizza and sugar shack components.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Pizza menu lists 'Hungry Hippie – Delicious deluxe veggie'; cafe menu includes a 'Gluten-Sensitive' section explicitly listed in the menu tabs

wow_evidence: beloved family-owned country destination... operating since 1987
